name: Production-face methane release
description: Increase the fictional Z04 methane source and observe transport, risk, and simulated safety response.

name: Main ventilation fan failure
description: Fail the simulated main fan after ten seconds and observe airflow loss and emergency precedence.

name: Face intake airway roof fall
description: At ten seconds a simulated roof fall multiplies the resistance of airway E03 (Z02 to the Z04 face) by 250; airflow redistributes to the heading branch and the face loses dilution air.

name: Production-face gas sensor communication loss
description: At ten seconds the Z04 methane and CO sensors stop reporting; the zone keeps its last reading marked stale and must be treated as unknown, never as safe.
